verdict.rationale: A data-use and AI-training privacy policy is a fair question for any hosted service that handles user data, including Tailscale's control plane, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented opt-out from AI training and no training-data policy. Aperture's ability to inspect or block LLM requests is a different feature (traffic control toward LLM providers), not a guarantee about Tailscale's own use of data for training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
